profile_text.body:
XPENG's Spanish site presents the company as a maker of fully electric cars, saying it has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. Its range in Spain covers the G6, G9 and P7+ models, which the site says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, allowing a charge from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the CERO label from the DGT and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160,000 km. The page invites visitors to leave their details for a test drive or more information, and names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the party responsible for processing the data submitted.

The site also lists financing examples. For the G6 RWD Standard Range it gives a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €, with a 36-month term, a debtor rate of 1,99% and a T.A.E. of 3,53%. For the XPENG G9 RWD Standard Range it gives a cash price of 56.590,30€, a debtor rate of 4,99% and a T.A.E. of 6,76%. Both offers are described as valid until 30/09/2026 and as financing offered by Open Bank, S.A., subject to study and approval.

The company is recorded as a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, trading under the ticker XPEV, with CIK 0001810997. No lawsuits, MCP servers or individual products are listed for it.
